title: Associative normalized compositors for arbitrary semilinear systems
statement:
Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be arbitrary commutative rings, and use the ordinary and unbounded derived semilinear system operations and specified adjunctions of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Here $P_f=D(f^*_{\bullet})$ denotes exact derived inverse image, $S_f=Rf_{*,\bullet}$ denotes total derived direct image, and $J_j=D(j_{!,\bullet})$ denotes open extension. For scheme maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$, let $d_{g,f}:P_fP_g\cong P_{gf}$ be exact localization of the unit-preserving ordinary inverse-image compositor; let $c_{g,f}:S_gS_f\cong S_{gf}$ be its right-adjoint conjugate. For open immersions $a:U\to V$, $b:V\to X$, let $e_{b,a}:J_bJ_a\cong J_{ba}$ be the corresponding open-adjoint compositor. These three families are associative and unital under the normalized identity comparisons. Explicitly
$$d_{hg,f}\circ(P_f d_{h,g})=d_{h,gf}\circ(d_{g,f}P_h),\quad c_{h,gf}\circ(S_h c_{g,f})=c_{hg,f}\circ(c_{h,g}S_f),$$
and $e_{c,ba}\circ(J_c e_{b,a})=e_{cb,a}\circ(e_{c,b}J_a)$ for composable opens $a,b,c$, with the functor associators understood. The same equations hold after transport along any supplied equalities of scheme morphisms. They refer to these specified adjunctions and do not assert equality of different adjunction structures.
